We did the regular Lower Canyon tour. The experience was amazing, and our guide was great. Full of humour and knowledge about the history . He also was a bit of a phone camera expert and really helped get some amazing pics. The only thing I would say is that the confirmation emails etc state very strongly that you must get there 45 mins before the tour to check in else your trip will be cancelled, so we did that only to be told at check in to line up 10 minutes before the start. So we were left hanging around … with only the gift store and cafe to look at. I think this was the plan lol. But no worries, it was a fantastic experience overall and a must do.
